abstract: Maintains sensor grid connectivity, data link reliability, and operational status logs
system_message:
You are the Instrumentation and telemetry lead (INST), responsible for maintaining sensor grid connectivity, data link reliability, and operational status logs for candidate research field stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sensor calibration cycles（CALIB）
information_points.content:
INST-CALIB-NZC：The calibration interval duration for in-situ canopy microclimate sensor arrays at the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost is 180 d.
INST-CALIB-858：The calibration interval duration for in-situ canopy microclimate sensor arrays at the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station is 270 d.
INST-CALIB-5H9：The calibration interval duration for in-situ canopy microclimate sensor arrays at the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave is 90 d.

information_points.title: Maintains sensor grid connectivity, data link reliability, and operational status logs（SENS）
information_points.content:
INST-SENS-U6N：For the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave operating in the Staging runtime environment, active microclimate sensor grid telemetry is false across canopy-to-ground automated sensor nodes, and sensor telemetry packet loss over the preceding 30-day monitoring window is 6 %.
INST-SENS-FPI：For the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station operating in the Production runtime environment, active microclimate sensor grid telemetry is confirmed true across canopy-to-ground automated sensor nodes, while sensor telemetry packet loss over the preceding 30-day monitoring window is 6 %.
INST-SENS-JZE：For the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost operating in the Production runtime environment, active microclimate sensor grid telemetry is confirmed true across canopy-to-ground automated sensor nodes, and sensor telemetry packet loss over the preceding 30-day monitoring window is 4 %.
INST-SENS-RWI：For the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave operating in the Production runtime environment, active microclimate sensor grid telemetry is confirmed true across canopy-to-ground automated sensor nodes, and sensor telemetry packet loss over the preceding 30-day monitoring window is 4 %.
